newsitem.title: USA: Air Transport to acquire Piedmont.
newsitem.headline: Air Transport to acquire Piedmont.

text.p: Air Transportation Holding Co. Inc. has a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Piedmont Holding Co. Inc. in a stock and cash deal worth more than $54.8 million.
The deal is subject to approval by the board of directors of both companies, execution of a definitive agreement and regulatory clearance.
Piedmont, a general aviation company based in Winston-Salem, N.C., was spun off by USAir in 1992. Its Pace Airline subsidiary is the largest private and corporate charter operator in the Southeast.

Air Transportation, based in Maiden, N.C., provides overnight air freight service to the express delivery industry and aircraft parts brokerage, engine overhaul management and aircraft parts repair services. It is one of the nation's largest small aircraft air cargo operators, with flights in the eastern half of the United States and Canada, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
Air Transportation's stock rose 25 cents to $3.625 early on Nasdaq.
